summary.text: Cisco Aguilar is the Democratic Secretary of State of Nevada and won re-election on November 3, 2026, according to unofficial results.
He is an attorney and the founder of a sports technology company, and was first elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Aguilar earned a B.S. in finance and accounting, an M.B.A. and a J.D., all from the University of Arizona.

He worked as special counsel to the chancellor of the Nevada System of Higher Education and as general counsel for the Andre Agassi Foundation for Education, and was appointed to the Nevada Athletic Commission by Govs. Gibbons and Sandoval.
Aguilar founded the sports technology company Blueprint Sports & Entertainment.
A Democrat, he was elected Secretary of State in 2022, defeating Jim Marchant, and faced him again in a 2026 rematch.
During the campaign, he highlighted business-licensing modernization, election cybersecurity and protections for election workers.

He won the November 3, 2026 general election for Secretary of State of Nevada with 57.0% of the vote to Jim Marchant's 39.3% and Brad Lee Barnhill's 1.5% and 1 other candidate, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
